verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence says Brex offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec or an equivalent such as a Postman collection. A probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every one. The '/openapi/' segment in one docs URL points to a Markdown page, not a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file and Postman testing docs are related machine-readable or testing aids, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
